title: Missing vector reserve before bulk insertion
summary: Growing std::vector or similar containers without reserving when size is known or bounded.
rationale: Repeated reallocation and copying/moving waste CPU and memory bandwidth.

detection.notes: Detect push_back/emplace_back loops where count is known but reserve is absent.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Call reserve with a realistic bound before bulk insertion.
remediation.tradeoffs: Over-reserving can waste memory; use known or conservative bounds.
